answer: By binding agents to recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, identity spoofing is information-theoretically infeasible, debunking the fable of trivial Sybil cloning. Thus, Byzantine fault-tolerant cryptographic finality mechanisms synthesize these unforgeability bounds, rendering adversarial manipulation as constrained as solid copper.
